text:
Is there someone here who made aliyah after conversion via ITIM?

I made a change of faith at misrad hapnim. Then I contacted them several times and they ignored me. Now I have received an invitation to an appointment, but no details of what the appointment is. It is also three quarters of a year before our planned meeting. So maybe it is about changing of the status?

What documents did you have with you? I have contacted a lawyer, but maybe it is more simple? I would be happy to hear from anyone who suceeded after making any private conversion.
